authorization.scope: Complete only V2 Milestone 4 for the sole contract-recognized inherited London candidate.
authorization.verbatim: if everything looks great and no contract negotiation needed lets proceed to milestone 4

cost_stress.formula: stressed selected net P&L per ounce = direction-adjusted gross move per ounce - 1.5 * frozen base cost per ounce

fold_design.assignment: Use each calendar test year exactly once. At a fold boundary, the training window contains only earlier development dates. The candidate has no fitted parameter and remains unchanged.
fold_design.warmup_role: Calendar 2021 from August is training evidence only and is never reported as a forward test fold.

aggregate_forward_gates: Every one of the three test folds passes every test-fold support, mapping, economic, control, and cost-stress gate.
The combined 2022-2024 forward-fold ISO-week cluster-bootstrap lower 95% mean-return bound is above zero.
The combined forward-fold cluster sign-flip q-value for the one-candidate family is at or below 0.10.
gate_evaluation.rejection_policy: If any required gate fails, reject internal walk-forward stability. Do not retune, replace, add a filter, change a fold, relax a gate, or promote a Milestone 3 q-failed relationship.
test_fold_gates: At least 80 POSITIVE-to-LONG and 80 NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cases.
Each directional state spans at least 35 ISO-week clusters.
Mean net return after frozen 1.0x costs is above zero.
Profit factor after frozen 1.0x costs is above one.
Mean return beats the better ALWAYS_LONG or ALWAYS_SHORT control on exactly the same directional cases.
POSITIVE-to-LONG and NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cells each have mean net return above zero.
Mean selected P&L remains above zero at 1.5x frozen costs.
training_boundary_gates: At least 30 POSITIVE-to-LONG and 30 NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cases.
Each directional state spans at least 15 ISO-week clusters.
Cumulative training mean net return is above zero.
Cumulative training profit factor is above one.
Cumulative training mean beats the better matched-direction unconditional control.
Cumulative POSITIVE-to-LONG and NEGATIVE-to-SHORT means are each above zero.

multiplicity.role: The one-candidate BH q-value equals its cluster sign-flip p-value. This does not erase the candidate's post-hoc origin.

cluster_bootstrap.confidence_interval: Type-7 2.5 and 97.5 percent quantiles of bootstrapped mean net return.
cluster_bootstrap.seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(manifest hash | candidate code | window id | BOOTSTRAP)

cluster_sign_flip_test.alternative: Mean selected return is greater than zero.
cluster_sign_flip_test.method: Independently multiply every ISO-week cluster's return sum by +1 or -1 with equal probability, preserve its observation count, and compare the randomized weighted mean with the observed mean.
cluster_sign_flip_test.seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(manifest hash | candidate code | window id | SIGN_FLIP)
